_comment: Formal ontology for The Family of Man corpus. All values are derived from files read in the 2026-05-16 session: data/photographs.csv, data/photographers.csv, data/sections.csv, research/world-tour.md, research/clervaux.md. No external URL was fetched in this round.

classes.label: Photograph
classes.description: A single still image that appeared in the 1955 exhibition. Corresponds to one row in data/photographs.csv.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.example: Checklist #2, Section 1 Prologue. Wynn Bullock, American. Print size 50 x 63 cm.

known_gaps: clervaux_on_display is 'unknown' for all 490 rows — no per-plate CNA inventory has been fetched
moma_object_id is blank for most rows; only 2 rows carry identifications, both flagged as reported-not-verified

489 of 490 rows carry title='Untitled' — the MoMA Master Checklist carries no per-plate titles. The single non-Untitled row is photo-0488 ('A Walk to Paradise Garden', W. Eugene Smith's closing plate), titled in the CSV from widespread secondary-source identification.

classes.label: Photographer
classes.description: A person (or institution acting as credit line) named in the MoMA Master Checklist as the maker of one or more plates. Corresponds to one row in data/photographers.csv.

attributes.name: gender
attributes.example: blank — filled only from self-identification or reputable source

attributes.name: notes
attributes.example: Appears at plates #2 and #6 of the Prologue...

known_gaps: The photographs.csv contains 271 unique photographer credit values (verified by unique-value count in this session); only 46 have photographer rows as of this session
birth_year and death_year are blank for most rows pending Tier-1/2 biographical source fetch
gender is intentionally blank per policy unless self-identification or reputable source supplies it

classes.label: Section
classes.description: One of eleven thematic clusters grouping the 503 plates. Corresponds to one row in data/sections.csv. These clusters are a corpus editorial grouping, not a verbatim replication of the MoMA Master Checklist's 42 internal sections.

attributes.name: theme
attributes.example: Entry — crowds and the human collective

attributes.name: sandburg_prologue_excerpt
attributes.example: blank — physical catalog not accessed in any session; anti-confabulation policy requires this remain empty

classes.label: Plate
classes.description: The exhibition-instance of a Photograph — identified by its MoMA Master Checklist plate number and characterised by dimensions and agency credit. Modeled as attributes of Photograph in data/photographs.csv (notes column) rather than as a separate file.

attributes.name: agency_affiliation
attributes.example: LIFE, Rapho Guillumette, Popular Photography, Magnum

classes.note: One Photograph may appear at multiple installation positions (e.g., photo-0008 / plate #11A is installed at six points across the checklist). The CSV records only the primary instance (#11A); secondary instances are noted in the notes column.

classes.label: Edition
classes.description: A physically distinct copy of the exhibition produced for circulation. Multiple editions co-existed in the field simultaneously. Partially instantiated — no dedicated CSV file.

classes.label: TourStop
classes.description: A specific showing of the exhibition at one venue in one city, anchored by at least one source supplying city, venue, and date. Country-level-only listings are not TourStops.

source_anchored_examples.venue: No. 4 Calle Lafragua (hall facing Monument to the Revolution)
Musée National d'Art Moderne (Palais de Tokyo)
Kalemegdan Pavilion / Cvijeta Zuzorić Art Pavilion

classes.label: Source
classes.description: A bibliographic entry corresponding to one source file in sources/<decade>/<slug>.md.

frontmatter_schema.title: string
frontmatter_schema.author: string
frontmatter_schema.type: enum: book | article | archive | institutional | thesis | newspaper | blog

classes.label: Critic / Scholar
classes.description: The author of a Source. Appears as the 'author' frontmatter field. No dedicated data file as of 2026-05-16.
